annotations.title: List a flow's guest share links

description: Every guest link on one flow, newest first: label, whether it's still live, the shareUrl (live links only — dead ones have no URL), expiry, and how many guests and messages it has seen. Use it to answer 'who has access', to recover a link the user lost, and to get the shareId for workbench_flows_shares_revoke.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_flows_shares_list
title: List a flow's guest share links
